`Dict()` should resolve to `{"type": "object", "additionalProperties": {}}`
`Dict` will output the schema of the `values` field as `additionalProperties`, you can see that in the example below with `Dict(values=Integer)` -> `additionalProperties: {type: integer}` and `Dict(values=Raw)` -> `additionalProperties: {}` (OpenAPI's "any" type).

To my understanding, leaving `values` to its default of `None` will allow any value input, and is effectively the same as `Dict(values=Raw())`.  So it would make more sense to output the same schema (`additionalProperties: {}`), but instead it omits `additionalProperties` entirely.  This means only an empty object complies with the spec, which is obviously not the desired behavior of `Dict()`.

```python
from apispec import APISpec

from apispec.ext.marshmallow import MarshmallowPlugin
from marshmallow import Schema, fields

spec = APISpec(
    title="Test",
    version="1.0.0",
    openapi_version="3.0.2",
    plugins=[MarshmallowPlugin()],
)


class TestSchema(Schema):
    id = fields.Int()
    plain = fields.Dict()
    raw = fields.Dict(values=fields.Raw)
    integer = fields.Dict(values=fields.Integer)


spec.components.schema("Test", schema=TestSchema)
print(spec.to_yaml())
```

Gives

```
paths: {}
info:
  title: Test
  version: 1.0.0
openapi: 3.0.2
components:
  schemas:
    Test:
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          type: integer
        plain:
          type: object
        raw:
          type: object
          additionalProperties: {}
        integer:
          type: object
          additionalProperties:
            type: integer
```

import json,sys
from apispec import APISpec
from apispec.ext.marshmallow import MarshmallowPlugin
from marshmallow import Schema,fields
class S(Schema):
    plain=fields.Dict()
    raw=fields.Dict(values=fields.Raw())
    integer=fields.Dict(values=fields.Integer())
    scalar=fields.Integer()
spec=APISpec(title="API",version="1",openapi_version="3.0.2",plugins=[MarshmallowPlugin()])
spec.components.schema("S",schema=S)

       {'case':'integer_dict','schema':p['integer'],'pass':p['integer']=={'type':'object','additionalProperties':{'type':'integer'}}},
       {'case':'scalar_unchanged','schema':p['scalar'],'pass':p['scalar']=={'type':'integer'}}]
print(json.dumps({'cases':cases},sort_keys=True))
sys.exit(0 if all(c['pass'] for c in cases) else 1)
PY
